description: This file defines a server-side React component for rendering documentation pages within a Next.js application, including functions for generating metadata and static parameters.

methods.name: DocPage
methods.description: An async React component that fetches and transforms a documentation page and renders it with layout components.

methods.name: generateMetadata
methods.description: Async function to generate page metadata like title and description based on the document data.

methods.name: generateStaticParams
methods.description: Async function that generates URL parameter objects for static page generation based on available document pages.
